text.text_excerpt: I drive past this place often and have been waiting for them to open. I heard about Blue Dot through a friend. She told me that police officers were working behind the counters serving the donuts. Hmmm intriguing..Unfortunately, there were no police serving up fresh baked donuts this morning but the staff were very friendly and the donuts were awesome! Apparently, its own by a police officer. My friend must of gone at the right time! Back to the donut - I went for the more traditional dozen but they also have maple glazed with bacon and a PB&J donut that would be fun to try sometime. I also got a coffee which tasted burnt. Overall though with the staff & the tasty donuts I give them 4 sta...

I couldn't believe my eyes when I walked into Blue Dot this morning. My eyes were still puffy from being rudely awoken by my 6yr old this morning saying, "MOM I WANT DONUTS!! You said we can get donuts on Saturday!" So I dragged myself out of bed at 7:30 on the one day I could be sleeping late this week and put on a jacket and headed to Blue Dot. I saw the line hanging out of the place last weekend so it's probably good I got there so early. The two cases of baked deliciousness are filled with so many donuts. It's really a beautiful eye opening sight! I got 6 glazed, then a variety for the other 6, the glazed wedding cake donut was really good, so was the apple crisp. The glazed are reall...

A very good local donut shop featuring a lot of exotic items to meet any taste. I cam in hungry for my favorite chocolate covered cake and settled for a plain cake and it was good. I don't get into exotic donuts much outside of District but if thats your thing than this is your place for the many choices you have.
